title: Nirvāṇaṣaṭkam
subtitle: Six verses on the nature of the Self

source.edition: The Works of Sri Sankaracharya, vol. 16, Sri Vani Vilas Press, 1910
source.digitalText: Ambuda CC0 1.0; machine-readable text credit: Arun Prasad

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
मनोबुद्ध्यहंकारचित्तानि नाहं न कर्णे न जिह्वा न च घ्राणनेत्रे ।
न च व्योम भूमिर्न तेजो न वायुश्चिदानन्दरूपः शिवोऽहं शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am not the mind, intellect, ego, or inner mental field; I am not the ear, tongue, nose, or eyes; nor am I space, earth, fire, or air. I am Śiva, whose nature is consciousness and bliss; I am Śiva.

gloss.en: mind • intellect • ego • inner mental field
consciousness • of the nature of bliss
Śiva • I am • Śiva • I am

units.iast:
manobuddhyahaṃkāracittāni nāhaṃ na karṇe na jihvā na ca ghrāṇanetre |
na ca vyoma bhūmirna tejo na vāyuścidānandarūpaḥ śivo’haṃ śivo’ham ||

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
न च प्राणसंज्ञो न वै पञ्चवायुर्न वा सप्तधातुर्न वा पञ्चकोशः ।
न वाक्पाणिपादौ न चोपस्थपायू चिदानन्दरूपः शिवोऽहं शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am not what is called the vital force; nor am I the five vital winds, the seven bodily constituents, or the five sheaths. Nor am I speech, hands, feet, the generative organ, or the organ of elimination. I am Śiva, whose nature is consciousness and bliss; I am Śiva.

gloss.en: what is called the vital force
not • indeed • the five vital winds
not • or • the seven bodily constituents
not • and • generative organ • excretory organ
of the nature of consciousness and bliss
Śiva • I am • Śiva • I am

units.iast:
na ca prāṇasaṃjño na vai pañcavāyurna vā saptadhāturna vā pañcakośaḥ |
na vākpāṇipādau na copasthapāyū cidānandarūpaḥ śivo’haṃ śivo’ham ||

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
न मे द्वेषरागौ न मे लोभमोहौ मदो नैव मे नैव मात्सर्यभावः ।
न धर्मो न चार्थो न कामो न मोक्षश्चिदानन्दरूपः शिवोऽहं शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I have neither aversion nor attachment, neither greed nor delusion. I have no pride or jealousy. I am not dharma (duty), artha (worldly aim), kāma (desire), or mokṣa (liberation). I am Śiva, whose nature is consciousness and bliss; I am Śiva.

gloss.en: not • indeed • a state of jealousy
of the nature of consciousness and bliss
Śiva • I am • Śiva • I am

units.iast:
na me dveṣarāgau na me lobhamohau mado naiva me naiva mātsaryabhāvaḥ |
na dharmo na cārtho na kāmo na mokṣaścidānandarūpaḥ śivo’haṃ śivo’ham ||

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
न पुण्यं न पापं न सौख्यं न दुःखं न मन्त्रो न तीर्थं न वेदा न यज्ञाः ।
अहं भोजनं नैव भोज्यं न भोक्ता चिदानन्दरूपः शिवोऽहं शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am neither merit nor sin, neither happiness nor sorrow, neither mantra nor pilgrimage place, nor the Vedas or sacrifices. I am not the act of eating, what is eaten, or the eater. I am Śiva, whose nature is consciousness and bliss; I am Śiva.

gloss.en: of the nature of consciousness and bliss
Śiva • I am • Śiva • I am

units.iast:
na puṇyaṃ na pāpaṃ na saukhyaṃ na duḥkhaṃ na mantro na tīrthaṃ na vedā na yajñāḥ |
ahaṃ bhojanaṃ naiva bhojyaṃ na bhoktā cidānandarūpaḥ śivo’haṃ śivo’ham ||

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
न मृत्युर्न शङ्का न मे जातिभेदः पिता नैव मे नैव माता च जन्म ।
न बन्धुर्न मित्रं गुरुर्नैव शिष्यश्चिदानन्दरूपः शिवोऽहं शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I have neither death nor fear or doubt; for me there is no distinction of birth or class. I have no father, no mother, and no birth; no relative, friend, teacher, or disciple. I am Śiva, whose nature is consciousness and bliss; I am Śiva.

gloss.en: not • for me • distinction of birth or class
of the nature of consciousness and bliss
Śiva • I am • Śiva • I am

units.iast:
na mṛtyurna śaṅkā na me jātibhedaḥ pitā naiva me naiva mātā ca janma |
na bandhurna mitraṃ gururnaiva śiṣyaścidānandarūpaḥ śivo’haṃ śivo’ham ||

units.label: Verse 6
units.deva:
अहं निर्विकल्पो निराकाररूपो विभुत्वाच्च सर्वत्र सर्वेन्द्रियाणाम् ।
न चासंगतं नैव मुक्तिर्न बन्धश्चिदानन्दरूपः शिवोऽहं शिवोऽहम् ॥
units.translation: I am free of mental distinctions and formless. Because I am all-pervading, I am everywhere, present through all the senses. I am neither the state of non-attachment, nor liberation, nor bondage. I am Śiva, whose nature is consciousness and bliss; I am Śiva.

gloss.en: of the nature of consciousness and bliss
Śiva • I am • Śiva • I am

units.iast:
ahaṃ nirvikalpo nirākārarūpo vibhutvācca sarvatra sarvendriyāṇām |
na cāsaṃgataṃ naiva muktirna bandhaścidānandarūpaḥ śivo’haṃ śivo’ham ||

units.label: Closing colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ निर्वाणषट्कं संपूर्णम् ॥
units.translation: Thus the Nirvāṇaṣaṭkam is complete: it was composed by the revered Śaṅkara Bhagavat, supreme renunciant and teacher among wandering ascetics, disciple of the worship-worthy feet of Govinda Bhagavat.

gloss.en: of the teacher among wandering ascetics
whose feet are worthy of worship

units.iast: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau nirvāṇaṣaṭkaṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
